scenes.title: The Shadow in the Sparks
scenes.setting_description: standing in a dark garage workshop, welding sparks showering in background, wiping oil from muscular hands, cold dangerous tactical stare

scenes.title: The Uninvited Engine
scenes.setting_description: young mechanic looking nervously through garage shutter gaps into dark foggy rain, unmarked black SUV headlights glowing in distance

dialogues.speaker: Arjun
dialogues.text: అన్నా... ఈ టైమ్‌లో కస్టమర్లా? లేక దారి తప్పిన వాళ్లా?

scenes.title: Silent Preparation
scenes.setting_description: adult male operative Aditya Varma, slipping heavy steel wrench into black sleeve, dead serious combat readiness under swinging tungsten bulb

dialogues.speaker: Aditya
dialogues.text: అర్జున్... లోపలికి వెళ్లి వెనుక తలుపు బోల్ట్ వెయ్యి.

scenes.title: Breach on the Perimeter
scenes.setting_description: two black-clad masked mercenaries jumping over concrete wall with suppressed tactical pistols into muddy alleyway

dialogues.speaker: Narrator
dialogues.text: పదిహేడేళ్లుగా దాక్కున్న ఆ నిజం... ఈ రాత్రి వెలుగు చూడబోతోంది.

scenes.title: The Five-Second Interception
scenes.setting_description: Aditya Varma in close-quarters hand-to-hand combat, disarming armed attacker in doorway, rain and sweat, dark tactical athleticism
